definitions.usage: destruction, discomfiture, trouble, tumult, vexation, vexed.
definitions.full: H4103. mehumah מְהוּמָה noun feminine tumult, confusion, disquietde, discomfiture — absolute ׳מ Deut 7:23 7 t.; construct מְהוּמַת 1Sam 5:11 ; Ezek 22:5 ; plural absolute מְהוּמוֺת 2Chr 15:5 , מְהוּמֹת Amos 3:9 ; — 1 tumult, confusion Amos 3:9 (|| עֲשׁוּקִים oppression ), disturbance, turmoil (opposed to peace) 2Chr 15:5 (|| verb המם 15:6 ), compare Ezek 22:5 ; disquietude (of mind) Prov 15:16 ; especially tumult & confusion, panic , as due to divine judgment ׳מְהוּמַתיֿ Zech 14:13 compare Ezek 7:7 ; also 1Sam 5:9 and מָוֶת מְהוּמַת 5:11 . 2 discomfiture , (due to ׳י ) in war 1Sam 14:20 (compare 14:15 ; 14:22 ); Deut 7:23 (accusative of congnate meaning with verb with הום q. v.), 28:20 (|| מִגְעֶרֶת מְאֵרָה, ); compare מ ׳יוֺם 1Sam 22:5 (|| מְבוּכָה מְבוּסָה, ) a day of discomfiture & down-treading & confusion .
